As the result of continuous use the rust will erode into the internal caliper and the shaft becomes stuck causing decreased parking brake force. As the result as brake pad wear the clearance is not correctly adjusted and brake force becomes insufficient to hold a vehicle. In the worst case scenario parking brake will not work even though a lever is fully operated and parked vehicle may move.
richiami.rimedio: Anti-rust coating (Fluorine) has been applied to parking brake shaft from 27/01/2016 supplied parts & the Inspection process for the caliper has been changed from 14/12/2014 supplied parts.

This can lead to loss of automatic transmission fluid from the automatic gearbox, thus, there is a possibility of poor gear shifting and illumination of the warning light. In the worst case scenario, the vehicle can no longer be driven.

richiami.difetto: Due to a fault in the soldering process of the lighting switch circuit board it is possible that the solder on the lighting circuit switch can crack as a result of temperature changes during production. This can result in the lights or turn signals failing totally or blinking/flicker.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the switch and if required replace the switch assembly.
richiami.titolo: HEAD LIGHT AND INDICATOS MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: As a result of incorrect machining of the oil seal installation aperture in the transfer cover by one of the transfer box suppliers it is possible the oil seal may move from its intended position in the casing. This can result Automatic Transmission Fluid (ATF) passing from the main gearbox into the transfer casing causing the ATF pressure to drop which will result in poor shifting and the illumination of a warning lamp on the instrument panel. Also as the oil level in the transfer box increase it can leak out from the transfer box breather pipe onto the road surface. In the worst case scenario the vehicle can lose all drive.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the transfer box. If found to be one of the affected transfer boxes then the transfer box will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF DRIVE

richiami.difetto: Due to a nonconformity in the manufacture of the alternator pulley (free wheel type) the contact surface of the pulley might be deformed. In use the tightening torque of the alternator pulley can decrease resulting in the pulley detaching from the alternator. Should this happen the driver will notice reduced power steering assistance and the warning lamp for the charging system will illuminate.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and ascertain which alternator is fitted. Where an unmodified alternator is fitted replace the alternator.
richiami.titolo: REDUCTION IN POWER STEERING ASSISTANCE

As a result, this can cause increased blow-by gas to directly enter the crank case which in turn may cause the piston to overheat and melt. As a consequence, the engine may stall.

richiami.difetto: Soot may build on the piston ring causing the ring to seize in the groove allowing combustion gases to by-pass the piston. If not rectified this if ignored could cause the piston to overheat and melt.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to reprogram the engine ECU with new version software to change the pilot injection timing.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY STALL

richiami.difetto: On Petrol versions (HA1W) the air bubble separation function of the condenser tank for the engine cooling system may not function properly when the engine is running at high RPM. This could result in coolant overflowing from the condenser tank. If the coolant overflows repeatedly and use of the vehicle continues without sufficient coolant engine overheating could occur. In the worst case the engine could stall/heat seize and cannot be restarted
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to check and where necessary replace the condenser tank refill the coolant and bleed the system.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE COULD OVERHEAT AND STALL

This can result in the ACC system automatically applying the brakes to reduce vehicle speed. 2) Due to a calculation error in the ACC/Front Collision Mitigation (FCM) control unit ACC failure and Active Stability Control (ASC) failure may be displayed in the combination meter along with an audible warning alarm. The ACC and FCM systems will not operate when these warnings are displayed.

richiami.difetto: It is possible that moisture can enter the front wheel ABS sensors via its wiring due to insufficient waterproofing. This can cause the generation of an abnormal signal to the ABS ECU. This will normally be identified to the driver by the illumination of a warning light on the dash panel the fluctuation of the speedometer needle or noise produced by the false activation of the ABS system. In extreme cases it could affect the directional control of the vehicle or reduce the braking efficiency of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicle to replace the sensors.
richiami.titolo: BRAKING MAY BE REDUCED

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that after the vehicle has been stationary for some length of time increased pressure may need to be applied to the footbrake pedal to bring the vehicle to a stop. This is due to insufficient vacuum assistance within the brake booster  due to a failure of the check valve. It should be noted that on the second application of the footbrake the check valve will operate as designed and the brakes will operate as normal.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the brake booster check valve replaced.
richiami.titolo: LACK OF BRAKE SERVO ASSISTANCE

richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the brake booster check valve replaced.

Initially, it is difficult to press down the brake pedal while driving slowly (e.g. manoeuvring the vehicle), but the brake pedal then returns to normal.

richiami.difetto: Due to an incorrect manufacturing process the resin film within the brake assist accumulator may become damaged. If use continues in this condition a crack in the diaphragm may occur resulting in the depletion of the nitrogen gas resulting in (1) delay of the brake assist function under rapid braking. (2) An increase in the required brake pedal effort when the engine is started following a long period with the engine stopped.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the accumulator checked to identify whether or not it is one within the affected batch. Should this be the case the accumulator will be replaced with one of a modified type.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE PEDAL ASSIST FUNCTION MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY

richiami.difetto: The product poses a risk of injuries because, due to an improper manufacturing process of the hydraulic brake accumulator, the resin film (diaphragm) inside the accumulator may get damaged. If use continues under this condition, a crack in the diaphragm may occur and the amount of the nitrogen gas enclosed in the accumulator may decrease, resulting in the following phenomenon: 1. braking may be delayed if the user tries to brake rapidly, 2. more effort may need to be applied to the brake pedal when the engine has been started after a long stoppage period.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions take by the importer. · Date of entry into force: Unknown

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that due to an incorrect manufacturing process the U bolts used to secure the rear axle could break resulting initially in a rattling noise emanating from the rear axle. Should this be symptom be ignored insecurity of the rear axle could result.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the rear axle U bolts replaced with quality assured items.
richiami.titolo: REAR AXLE MAY BECOME INSECURE

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the engine fuel return pipe can become  damaged as the result of abrasion with it's fixation and harness.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will be checked for evidence of pipe damage which if none is evident protective covers will be installed. Should it be found that the pipes are damaged they will be replaced by pipes which are fitted with protective covers.
richiami.titolo: FUEL COULD LEAK FROM THE RESIN FUEL RETURN PIPE ON THE INLET MANIFOLD.

richiami.difetto: When a driver sequentially performs a quick gear shift down (high rpm 6th to 5th to 4th gear etc)during high speed driving (high engine load) the engine ECU can judge the engine to run in overrun condition. As a result to avoid engine damage the ECU will turn off the engine by stopping the fuel supply and closing the throttle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to re-programme the engine ECU.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY STALL

richiami.difetto: The product poses a risk of injuries and fire because there is a risk of fuel leakage on to rubber fuel return hoses, which could lead to self-ignition and cause a road accident.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that due to the formation of rust between the manual control shaft and the gear inhibitor switch the transmission may not move to the park position even though this may have been selected. As a result it may be impossible to start the vehicle additionally the vehicle may move unexpectedly whilst in park if the parking brake has not been applied.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the relevant components cleaned and fitted with a protective cover.
richiami.titolo: VEHICLE MAY NOT BE IN THE INTENDED GEAR

To avoid engine damage, the ECU will then turn off the engine. In such a situation, greater force would be necessary to use the vehicle steering and braking systems.

richiami.difetto: The front and rear propeller shafts and the right hand front drive shaft have been fitted with nuts of an incorrect specification. The concern could lead to vibration which if not attended to could lead to the detachment of a shaft and loss of drive.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the nuts and washers fitted to the front and rear propeller shafts and the right hand front drive shaft.
richiami.titolo: DRIVE SHAFT SECURING NUTS MAY LOOSEN

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the possibility exists that a bolt welded to the gearshift lever may fracture. Should this occur the adjustment may loosen and the shift cable may move. This can result in a mismatch between the gear shift selector and the actual gear selected. In the worst case the bolt may break which can cause the control cable to become disconnected and drive to be lost.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles will have the transmission shift lever replaced with a quality assured item.
richiami.titolo: DRIVE MAY BE LOST

richiami.difetto: When used regularly in severe off road conditions the ball joint of the pitman arm may break resulting in loss of steering control.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a modified pitman arm if this has not already been accomplished following a previous intervention.
richiami.titolo: STEERING CONTROL MAY BE LOST

richiami.difetto: A crack may occur in the fuel filter water sensor which can lead to a leakage of fuel.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the fuel filter water sensor replaced.
richiami.titolo: FUEL MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: The front left brake pipe may foul the power steering hose which can damage the brake pipe which may fail leading to loss of brake fluid.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles check pipe for damage if OK apply new securing clip. If damaged replace pipe with modified version.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE HOSE MAY FRACTURE

richiami.difetto: This product poses a serious risk of injuries because when the vehicle is regularly used under severe off road conditions, abnormal corrosion could occur on the pitman arm stud due to constant exposure to mud/water. This, in combination with excessive force applied to the pitman arm, could eventually lead to the failure of the pitman arm stud. The ball stud at the pitman arm, which connects the steering gearbox and the relay rod, can crack, so the driver cannot steer the vehicle, leading in the worst case to loss of steering control and accident.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: The VIN/chassis numbers of the affected vehicles are from the Start Of Production (SOP) till JMB0RK9601P000739. The recall concerns vehicles with production years from 1999 to 2001.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the importer  · Date of entry into force: Unknown

richiami.difetto: The mountings for the intercooler air inlet (bonnet air intake garnish) is inappropriate and heat from the engine may cause mount deformation resulting in increased stress on the mounts. This condition could cause the mounts to crack and in a worst case scenario the bonnet air intake garnish could fall off potentially creating a traffic obstruction.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit new air intake garnish mountings.
richiami.titolo: AIR INLET INTERCOOLER MOUNTS MAY CRACK

richiami.difetto: In the event of a rear end accident it is possible that the reclining mechanism of the second row seat could fail which may result in personal injury if the seat was occupied at the time.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit improved reclining adjusters to the second row seats.
richiami.titolo: REAR SEAT  MAY FAIL DURING REAR IMPACT

richiami.difetto: The Oil Cooler hose may fracture causing an oil leak
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and check gap between towing hook and oil cooler hose. If less than 15mm install modified pipe. If more than 15mm check pipe for damage and if necessary replace.
richiami.titolo: OIL MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: Upper coolant hose may detach causing loss of coolant.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit new coolant hose and clamps.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY OVERHEAT

richiami.difetto: A crack might occur in the water sensor that is mounted in the fuel filter due to a combination of the design of the sensor and the applied torque. The applied torque must be 6Nm (+/- 2Nm) and not 13Nm (+/- 2Nm). This can cause unstable idling and loss of output power, leading to possible loss of control of the vehicle.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: CR-L200. The recall concerns light commercial vehicles with a total permitted weight of 1 ton, with production year 2006. The VIN/chassis numbers for Greece is from MMBCNKB407D005820 to MMBJRKB407D022070.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective action taken by the importer · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: A crack might occur in the water sensor that is mounted in the fuel filter due to a combination of the design of the sensor and the applied torque.

richiami.difetto: The product poses a risk of injury because the backrest locking mechanism in the second row of seats is not strong enough and may fail in a rear-end collision.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: Mitsubishi Grandis 7-seater. The affected vehicles were produced in 2006 and have VINs from JMALJNA8W6Z001699 to JMBLRNA4W6Z001727.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective action taken by the producer · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The product poses a risk of injury because the backrest locking mechanism in the second row of seats is not strong enough and may fail in a rear-end collision.

richiami.difetto: Due to the improper design of the oil cooler hose, the clearance between towing hook and the engine oil cooler hose is not sufficient. This could lead to possible damage of the engine oil cooler hose and the engine oil cooler itself, resulting in insufficient cooling of the engine oil. The above condition may cause insufficient lubrication of the diesel engine, with possible damage to the engine and loss of control of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the importer. · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: Due to the improper design of the oil cooler hose, the clearance between towing hook and the engine oil cooler hose is not sufficient.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the original fitment exhaust pipe wall at the front of the main muffler is too thin additionally that the weld placement for the metal fitting supports is inappropriate. This may result in the exhaust pipe cracking due to vibration and if continually used in this condition the exhaust could fail resulting in excessive noise.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and check whether the exhaust is original. If this is the case a new exhaust box will be fitted.
richiami.titolo: EXHAUST PIPE COULD FAIL POTENTIALLY RESULTING IN EXCESSIVE NOISE

richiami.difetto: The possibility exists that the bonnet safety hook (secondary locking device) is defective. With the result that should the primary lock not be fully engaged the safety hook may also fail due to lift created by the airflow and in the worst case the bonnet may open whilst the vehicle is being driven.
richiami.rimedio: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled at which time the safety hook bracket will be checked for profile and adjusted if necessary.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT THE BONNET SAFETY HOOK IS DEFECTIVE

richiami.difetto: The front passenger side air bag may suffer delayed deployment which in the worst case scenario could result in passenger injury
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles will be recalled at which time the airbag will be replaced with a unit which complies with the correct deployment assessment criteria.
richiami.titolo: PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG MAY SUFFER DELAYED DEPLOYMENT

richiami.difetto: Possibility that water could seep into the lower ball joints of the front suspension due to insufficient sealing
richiami.rimedio: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled during which time the free play in the front suspension lower ball joints will be checked. If the play is found to be within tolerance and the dust cover is free from damage  the cover will be cleaned and a sealer applied. If on inspection the dust cover is damaged or the joint is exhibiting free play outside the tolerance the lower arm will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT WATER COULD SEEP INTO THE LOWER BALL JOINTS

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that due to improper fixing position of the front brake hose excessive stress may occur to the hose when continually operated on the steering system. In the worst case cracks may occur on the brake hose  which may result in a leak and a reduction in brake force.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to fit modified brake hoses and brackets
richiami.titolo: CRACKS MAY OCCUR ON THE BRAKE HOSE

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that due to improper operation when assembling the engine at production a crack occurred on the advance control lever of the cold start device on the injection pump.
richiami.rimedio: During specific vehicle usage there is a possibility that the engine rpm could increase if the cold start lever broke.
richiami.titolo: Engine rpm may increase unexpectedly

richiami.difetto: Due to insecure fitment of the pin in the gear shift control set there is a possibility that the pin could could fall out making it impossible to change gear.
richiami.rimedio: Check the tightness of the  gear shift pin if loose fit a new gear shift set. If the pin is tight a secondary locking arrangement will be fitted as a precaution.
richiami.titolo: INABILITY TO CHANGE GEAR

richiami.difetto: It is possible that due to improper welding of the levelling valve on the fuel tank fuel may leak from this area.
richiami.rimedio: Fit a new improved fuel tank.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAK

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the right hand airbag sensor is programmed with the wrong sensing direction software.  This might cause the right hand side airbag not to deploy in case of collision to the right hand side.
richiami.rimedio: All recalled vehicles will have the right hand side impact sensor replaced with the latest version.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE INCORRECT WIRING OF AIRBAG

richiami.difetto: Under severe and extreme conditions where the vehicle is used mainly off-road in a wet muddy environment it is possible that the tapered section of the ball pin on the steering Pitman arm may break. This in the worst case could result in a loss of steering control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the Pitman arm with a quality assured component.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL

richiami.difetto: The crankshaft pulley may become loose causing a rattling noise from the engine battery warning light to come on and a high steering effort will be noticed.
richiami.rimedio: All recalled vehicles will have the crankshaft pulley bolt tightened to the correct specified torque.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE CRANKSHAFT PULLEY CONCERN

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the accumulator diaphragm in the Hydraulic Brake Booster (HBB) might be manufactured improperly. This may cause the nitrogen pressure in the accumulator to drop. The following two symptoms may result :- 1) The brake assist might be delayed in sudden hard braking. 2) Relatively large brake pedal loads might be required after long-term parking and first engine start since specific brake pressure takes time to accumulate.
richiami.rimedio: The Hydraulic Brake Booster nitrogen accumulator will be replaced with a modified one on all affected vehicles.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF POWER ASSISTANCE TO BRAKES

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the fuel tank upper panel may suffer from fatigue failure due to repeated stress caused by the fuel tank breathing. In addition the Spacerunners will be checked for cracks on the check valve due to interference with the cross member.
richiami.rimedio: If any cracks are apparent the fuel tank will be replaced if no crack is visible a reinforcement plate will be fitted the check valve will be re-located.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE CRACKING OF FUEL TANK AND CHECK VALVE.

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the fuel tank upper panel may suffer from fatigue failure due to repeated stress caused by the fuel tank breathing. In addition the Spacerunners will be checked for cracks on the check valve due to interference with the cross member.
richiami.rimedio: If any cracks are apparent the fuel tank will be replaced if no crack is visible a reinforcement plate will be fitted the check valve will be re-located.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE CRACKING OF FUEL TANK AND CHECK VALVE.

richiami.difetto: The Active Yaw Control ECU may be incorrectly programmed which may cause the clutches in the torque transfer differential to remain disengaged when the engine starts. This could result in damage to the rear axle differential.
richiami.rimedio: Recall potentially affected vehicles and replace the Electronic Control Unit (ECU).
richiami.titolo: ACTIVE YAW CONTROL ECU CONCERN

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that due to water and dirt ingress into the lower arm ball joint the ball stud and joint case may suffer from premature wear. In the worst case the ball stud may come out of the ball joint case.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles inspect the lateral lower arm ball joints and replace if free play exceeds manufacturers specification.
richiami.titolo: SUSPENSION LOWER ARM BALL JOINT MAY SUFFER PREMATURE WEAR

richiami.difetto: Under severe and extreme conditions where the vehicle is used mainly off-road in a wet muddy environment it is possible that the tapered section of the ball pin on the steering 'Pitman arm' may break. This in the worst case could result in a loss of steering control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and replacing the  Pitman arm with a quality assured component.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the fuel tank may be incorrectly welded on its upper panel and baffle plate in the tank causing it to crack on the welded position. In the worst case this may cause the fuel tank to leak fuel.
richiami.rimedio: Inspect the vehicles replace the fuel tanks if leaking and in cases where no abnormality is found apply a protector plate.
richiami.titolo: FUEL TANK MAY CRACK AND LEAK

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that a condenser may become detached from the circuit board due to the breakage of the component wiring. The engine may stop or be difficult to start.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and apply silicone to the condenser to act as a vibration damper to counteract shocks that can be transmitted from the suspension through the body to the circuit board.
richiami.titolo: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT THE ENGINE MAY STOP WHEN DRIVING

richiami.difetto: The Crankshaft Pulley securing bolt may not have been correctly torqued. The bolt may loosen or break and in the worst case result in detachment of the pulley.
richiami.rimedio: All engines up to engine number YD2145 - remove pulley securing bolt increase the depth of the thread in the Crankshaft by 5 mm. Check bolt for damage and renew if necessary. Lubricate threads refit and tighten to specified torque. Engines numbered from YD2146 onwards - remove pulley securing bolt examine for damage and renew if necessary lubricate threads refit and tighten to specified torque.
richiami.titolo: POTENTIAL DETACHMENT OF CRANKSHAFT PULLEY

richiami.difetto: Brake fluid may seep from the front flexible brake hoses impairing the efficiency of one or both braking circuits.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of both front flexible brake hoses.
richiami.titolo: FRONT FLEXIBLE BRAKE HOSE

richiami.difetto: The nipple for the brake booster vacuum hose may become choked due to adhesion and accumulation of combustion products from the engine. This may cause in the worst case reduced braking efficiency after operating the brake pedal several times in a short period.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to relocate nipple from intake manifold to resonator to avoid accumulation of combustion products.
richiami.titolo: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED

richiami.difetto: The nipple for the brake booster vacuum hose may become choked due to adhesion and accumulation of combustion products from the engine. This may cause in the worst case reduced braking efficiency after operating the brake pedal several times in a short period.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to relocate nipple from intake manifold to resonator to avoid accumulation of combustion products.
richiami.titolo: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE REDUCED

richiami.difetto: The brake booster vacuum hose check valve may stick and cause a loss of vacuum to the brake booster. This will result in greatly increased brake pedal effort and increased stopping distances.
richiami.rimedio: The affected vehicles are being recalled to have the brake booster vacuum hose replaced with a quality assured unit.
richiami.titolo: LOSS OF BRAKING SYSTEM VACUUM ASSISTANCE

richiami.difetto: It is possible that installation of the front brake hoses has not been correctly carried out during initial assembly.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of replacement brake hoses.
richiami.titolo: FRONT BRAKE HOSES MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY INSTALLED DURING ASSEMBLY
